  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE != "true" and deterministic_skip_head_is_current fails because the head moved, auto_merge_summary retains "disabled by ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE" instead of reporting that labels were withheld due to the moved head.
  WHY: Functional behavior is correct and labels are safely withheld, but the operator-facing summary conflates auto-merge configuration with a concurrent-push refusal.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:48 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The freshness re-read suppresses stderr with 2>/dev/null when reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels calls gh api.
  WHY: Labels are correctly refused when the call fails, but operators cannot distinguish a rate-limit/5xx from a 404/auth failure without manually rerunning the command.

If the SHA is unknown, refuse the merge with a `::warning::` (fail closed, same posture as `review_rb_judge.sh`)."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` gate outputs and `deterministic-skip-merge` job
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Gate output `head_sha` exposed at line 257 and emitted at line 1087; `deterministic-skip-merge` consumes it via `PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.head_sha }}` at line 1315. Both merge strategies (forward-merge-fallback `--merge --auto` at line 1406 and squash `--squash --auto` at line 1423) carry `--match-head-commit "${PR_HEAD_SHA}"`. Empty-`PR_HEAD_SHA` branch at lines 1389-1391 logs `::warning::` and refuses. Deliverable fully implemented.

  expected_change_site: `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` env doc, freshness guards, and both `gh pr merge` calls
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA` declared in env input list at line 15. Missing-SHA refusal at lines 183-186 emits `::warning::` and exits 0. Freshness check at lines 182-190 re-reads PR metadata and rejects mismatched heads. Forward-merge-fallback call at line 231 and squash call at line 281 both pass `--match-head-commit "${INITIAL_HEAD_SHA}"`. Helper outputs `AUTO_MERGE_READY_LABELS_ALLOWED` to `GITHUB_ENV` (line 19-20, 30-37, 232, 238, 262, 282) so the workflow can gate the `Mark linked issues ready to merge` step. Deliverable fully implemented.

  EVIDENCE: `test_review_enable_auto_merge_helper_is_bootstrapped_and_delegated` (lines 3119-3137), `test_reviewed_head_authorization_precedes_ready_labels` (lines 3140-3147), and `test_checkout_captures_initial_head_sha_before_non_push_exits` (lines 3150-3159) cover the helper side. `test_auto_merge_guard_suppresses_forward_merge_fallback_pr_on_deterministic_skip_path` (lines 5832-5855) and `test_gate_emits_head_ref_output_for_forward_merge_suppressor_reuse` (lines 5867-5881) cover the workflow side. README rows at lines 78-84 and 105-118 were updated. Deliverable fully implemented.
- requirement: "The workflow now withholds `ai:review-skipped` and `ai:ready-to-merge` when bound merge authorization fails."
  expected_change_site: `deterministic-skip-merge` label application and codex-agent "Mark linked issues ready to merge" `if:` predicate
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `deterministic-skip-merge` skips both labels via `if [ "${auto_merge_ready_labels_allowed}" != "true" ]; then ... write_deterministic_skip_summary; exit 0` at lines 1433-1437. The "Mark linked issues ready to merge" predicate at line 5571 adds `env.AUTO_MERGE_READY_LABELS_ALLOWED == 'true'`, recorded by `review_enable_auto_merge.sh` only on successful bound enrollment. The integration-PR branch at line 262 unconditionally records `true`, which is intentional because orchestrator integration PRs are auto-merge-suppressed and handled by the poller.

  expected_change_site: `changelog.d/4109-bind-auto-merge-head.md`
  confidence=5

  EVIDENCE: `changelog.d/4109-bind-auto-merge-head.md` lines 1-6 carry the `<!-- changelog: fixed -->` marker, the headline, a 4-sentence lead, and the `What this means for operators:` closing paragraph. Workspace source manifest at line 205 records the new fragment path. Both required structure requirements are met.
